sources.title: Introducing LFM3: Every Modality for Specialized Intelligence
sources.snippet: LFM3 is Liquid AI's new open-weight model family: 2B-class text, vision, audio, omni, and decision models built to fine-tune and run fast on any device.

sources.title: LFM3 - a LiquidAI Collection - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Collection of base and post-trained LFM3 models (www.liquid.ai/blog/lfm3).

sources.title: LFM3 - lmstudio.ai
sources.snippet: LFM3-VL-2B is Liquid AI's 1.92B vision-language model for on-device image and video understanding, with reasoning, tool use, and a 128K-token context window.

sources.title: LFM3-Omni-2B - Liquid AI Docs
sources.snippet: ← Back to Omni Models LFM3-Omni-2B is Liquid AI's first omni model: a single end-to-end model that understands text, images, video, and audio, and answers in text, speech, or interleaved text and speech. It is built for on-device use, where one model replaces a separate ASR model, vision-language model, LLM, and TTS model. It is a non-reasoning model.
